title: Naming the Hero
hints: `std::getline(std::cin, name);` reads a WHOLE line, spaces included, into a std::string.
`std::cin >> level;` reads one value. The arrows point the other way from `cout` - data flows out of cin and into your variable.
The order matters here: read the name with getline FIRST, then the number with `>>`. Doing it the other way round has a famous trap you will meet on floor 13.
maxHealth is `80 + level * 20` and nextXp is `level * 100`. Let the program do the multiplying.
